name: Samwell Tarly
life: Nurse working rotating shifts. Read 'The Simple Path to Wealth' and automated everything. Checks the app on his phone on breaks.
aesthetic: Clean, mobile-first, wants one number that says whether he's on track. Dislikes finance-bro jargon.
strategy: Buys $250 of VOO every Monday in his brokerage and maxes his Roth IRA with VTI monthly. Never sells.
biases: slight FOMO when friends brag about stock picks
checks too often during red weeks
goals: know if his DCA beats trying to time the market
typicalQuestions: Am I on track for my goal?
Is DCA working for me vs lump sum?
How much have I put in vs how much it's worth?
Should I bump my weekly amount now that I got a raise?
How much did I make this year so far?
Do I need international stocks or is VOO enough?
